chapter: King Oliver's band and early jazz
title: Who was in King Oliver's band when he joined
summary: He lists Albert Nicholas, Darnell Howard, Paul Barbarin, Luis Russell, Bert Cobb and Bud Scott, but cannot recall a trombonist and another trumpeter.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Who was in King Oliver's band when you joined it?

Albert Nicholas, Darnell Howard, Paul Barbarin, Luis Russell, a tuba player named -- oh, what was his name? -- Cobb, Bert Cobb. And there was another Cobb playing -- No, Bud Scott playing banjo, the guitar. And a trombone player from New Orleans. I can't think of his name. He was a real nice man, though. I can't think of his name offhand. And that's about it. And, oh, yeah, another trumpet player. Oh, God -- I'll think about it. Oh, God, and I knew him well, too, a very fine musician. Skip it. I'll --
Okay. When you think of it we can drop it in anywhere.
